 Your 11.11 Beauty Haul Might Be in Luck With These Finds From Lucky Beauty
 Deals 
 November 10, 2026 
 Regine Tan 
 If you’ve been meaning to restock your makeup bag or try a few new products, this could be a good time to check out Lucky Beauty’s online deals. The local beauty brand has several items marked down on its official stores , with discounts across complexion products, lip essentials, brow makeup, and fragrances. 
 There are options for putting together an everyday makeup routine, adding a little color to your look, or picking up a new scent. Some products are listed at over 60% off, with select items priced at around ₱100. If you’re planning to shop for beauty finds without spending too much, here are some Lucky Beauty deals to check out. 
 Complexion and Base Makeup 
 1. Lucky Beauty Serum Concealer 
 Photo: Lucky Beauty Shopee
 A concealer can do more than cover blemishes and dark circles. Lucky Beauty’s Serum Concealer is designed for concealing, contouring, and brightening, with a buildable medium-to-full coverage. It also has a lightweight, hydrating texture and a natural-looking finish, making it an option for anyone who prefers a little more coverage without using a full foundation. BUY IT HERE! 
 2. Lucky Beauty Angel Skin Veil 
 Photo: Lucky Beauty Shopee
 For days when you prefer a lighter base, the Angel Skin Veil is worth checking out. This skin tint offers light-to-medium buildable coverage with a soft-matte finish, helping even out the complexion without feeling like a full layer of foundation. It comes in multiple shades, too, so you can browse the available options to find one that suits your skin tone. BUY IT HERE! 
 3. Lucky Beauty Skin Blur Powder Foundation 
 Photo: Lucky Beauty Shopee
 If you prefer powder products for your base, the Skin Blur Powder Foundation combines foundation coverage with the convenience of a pressed powder. Its finely milled formula gives the skin a soft, velvety finish, with medium-to-buildable coverage that can also be used for setting and touch-ups. BUY IT HERE! 
 Lip and Cheek Products 
 4. Lucky Beauty Lip Sweetener 
 Photo: Lucky Beauty Shopee
 For a glossy finish, the Lucky Beauty Lip Sweetener is a lip product worth checking out. It has a semi-opaque, high-shine finish that adds color while giving the lips a hydrated appearance. It can also be worn on top of other products to add a little more shine to your daily lip. BUY IT HERE! 
 5. Lucky Beauty Dewy Lip Stain 
 Photo: Lucky Beauty Shopee
 If you prefer a lip tint that leaves color behind, check out the Lucky Beauty Dewy Lip Stain. Its formula adds a wash of color with a glossy finish, while leaving a stain on the lips as the shine wears off. The brand also describes it as moisturizing and non-sticky, making it an option for everyday lip color.  BUY IT HERE! 
 6. Lucky Beauty Lip Spicer 
 Photo: Lucky Beauty Shopee
 The Lip Spicer is Lucky Beauty’s lip plumper, making it an option for anyone who wants to add another step to their lip routine. You can browse the available product details and shades on the official store before checking out. BUY IT HERE! 
 7. Lucky Beauty Mini Blush & Lip Cream 
 Photo: Lucky Beauty Shopee
 Check out the Mini Blush & Lip Cream. Its multi-use format makes it a handy addition to a smaller makeup pouch, especially if you prefer a coordinating shade on different areas of your face.  BUY IT HERE! 
 Color Products for Your Makeup Bag 
 8. Lucky Beauty Ethereal Liquid Pigment in Glow 
 Photo: Lucky Beauty Shopee
 If you want to add a little radiance to your makeup look, the Ethereal Liquid Pigment in Glow is one shade to check out. The liquid pigment format gives you an option for adding color and dimension to your complexion, depending on how you apply and blend it. BUY IT HERE! 
 9. Lucky Beauty Ethereal Liquid Pigment in Flush 
 Photo: Lucky Beauty Shopee
 The Flush shade of the Ethereal Liquid Pigment is a liquid cheek color designed to give the cheeks a natural-looking wash of color. Its lightweight, blendable formula allows you to build up the intensity depending on the finish you’re after.  BUY IT HERE! 
 10. Lucky Beauty Ethereal Liquid Pigment in Sculpt 
 Photo: Lucky Beauty Shopee
 For a more defined makeup look, the Ethereal Liquid Pigment in Sculpt offers a shade intended for adding dimension to the face. Its liquid format can be blended into the complexion and built up gradually, depending on how much definition you want. BUY IT HERE! 
 Brow and Eye Makeup Finds 
 11. Lucky Beauty Micro Stroke Brow Pen 
 Photo: Lucky Beauty Shopee
 For anyone who prefers a more defined brow look, the Micro Stroke Brow Pen is worth a look. Its pen format is designed for drawing fine, precise strokes that can help fill in sparse areas and add definition to the brows.  BUY IT HERE! 
 12. Lucky Beauty Brow Grip Extra Hold 
 Photo: Lucky Beauty Shopee
 If you prefer styling your brows with a gel, the Brow Grip Extra Hold is another product to add to your list. Brow gels are useful for setting brow hairs in place after filling them in, and this one is part of Lucky Beauty’s Brow Trilogy collection. BUY IT HERE! 
 Fragrance and Hair Products 
 13. Lucky Beauty Hair Potion 
 Photo: Lucky Beauty Shopee
 Your hair can also be part of your fragrance routine. Lucky Beauty’s Hair Potion is a hair perfume designed to add scent to your strands, giving you another way to wear your favorite fragrance throughout the day. BUY IT HERE! 
 14. Lucky Beauty Mini Lucky Potions 
 Photo: Lucky Beauty Shopee
 If you’re curious about Lucky Beauty’s fragrance collection, the Mini Lucky Potions come in a 15ml size that’s easy to bring along when you’re out. The smaller bottles also give you a chance to explore the brand’s scents before committing to a bigger bottle. BUY IT HERE! 
 15. Lucky Beauty Lucky Potions Standard Box 
 Photo: Lucky Beauty Shopee
 The Lucky Beauty Lucky Potions Standard Box is worth checking out if you’re looking to explore the brand’s growing fragrance collection. The lineup now goes beyond its original scents, Stories for a Girl, Diary of a Lady, and Letters from a Woman, with newer releases such as Aura of Bliss, State of Grace, Moment of Peace, and Vanilla Éclat. BUY IT HERE! 
 If you’ve been planning to restock your makeup pouch or try something new from the brand, shop Lucky Beauty on Shopee .
